how.tagline: Castaways voted out one by one
how.premise: Eighteen castaways start in three tribes. Every episode someone is voted out, until the people voted out late in the game, the jury, choose the Sole Survivor.

segments.name: Reward challenge
segments.summary: The winners get food, comfort or a trip.

segments.name: Immunity challenge
segments.summary: Win it and you can't be voted out.

segments.name: Fire-making
segments.summary: Two make fire, one goes home.

season.label: The season

phases.name: Tribes
phases.summary: Challenges are won as a tribe. The losing tribe goes to Tribal Council.

phases.name: Merged
phases.summary: No tribes. Challenges are individual. Everyone voted out from here sits on the jury.

season.finale: Fire-making at the final four decides one finalist. The jury votes for a winner from the final three.

who.label: Who's playing
who.groups: Tribes change at set points. Tribes end when Merged begins.

waysOut.label: Ways out
waysOut.end: Fire-making at the final four decides one finalist. The jury votes for a winner from the final three.

items.name: Idols and advantages
items.line: Found at camp or on journeys. Played at Tribal Council to stay safe or cancel votes.

items.name: Journeys
items.line: A side trip. Some come back with an advantage, some without their vote.

items.name: Exile
items.line: Sent away from their tribe for a while, still in the game.
